note: Smoke test of the PyTorch cu130 build on a Blackwell card (RTX 50-series, RTX PRO 6000, B200), 2026-10-17. Blackwell is opt-in per run (machine.blackwell: true) until this has passed. Train only, cut 4, a tiny network on 20,000 labels, 3 epochs, device cuda (the chunk fails if the GPU check fails): it proves that the machine installs the cu130 group from the image, that torch sees the card and trains on it, and that rung.json records python_env.group cu130 with the compute capability (10.0 or 12.0) and device.json the GPU. Needs: an image built (Actions: image) from eng-cu130 or later, the release binaries of that commit as bin_sha, and the vast-run inputs min_cores 16 (the input's default of 190 would otherwise win over this manifest's 16), max_dollars 2, cheapest ticked. Not a measure of strength.
